params._credit: credit (liquidity amount) to be added to this pool

returns._pending: pending preium for the caller index

params._memo: additional memo for the payout report (to be emmited within event) payout ratio is determined by numerator/denominator (e.g. 50/100 = 50% payout
params._merkleRoot: Merkle root of the payout id list
params._pending: length of time to allow policyholders to redeem their policy
params._rawdata: raw data before the data set is coverted to merkle tree (to be emiｔted within event)

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the value {ERC20} uses, unless this function is overridden; NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

returns._mintAmount: the amount of iTokens minted from the transaction

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params._metaData: arbitrary string to store market information

params._maxCost: maximum cost to pay for the premium. revert if the premium is higher
params._target: Insurance type id. eg Smart Contract Hacking Cover = 0x00..00

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

returns._0: The balance of credit allocated by the specified index
The pending premium for the specified index
The value against the underlying tokens balance.

params._id: the id of the insurance policy
params._merkleProof: merkle proof (similar to "verify" function of MerkleProof.sol of OpenZeppelin Ref: https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/blob/master/contracts/utils/cryptography/MerkleProof.sol

params._index: index number of an index pool to get registered in the pool

params._state: true to set paused and vice versa

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. Requirements: - `sender` and `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - `sender` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``sender``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

params._id: id of the insurance policy to unlock liquidity

params._owner: the target address to look up value

returns._0: The balance of underlying tokens for the specified address

params._credit: credit (liquidity amount) to be withdrawn from this pool

returns._pending: pending preium for the caller index

returns._amount: the number of the iTokens corresponding to _value

allocateCredit(uint256).notice: Allocate credit from an index. Allocated credits are deemed as equivalent liquidity as real token deposits.

availableBalance().notice: Returns the amount of underlying tokens available for withdrawals

deposit(uint256).notice: A liquidity provider supplies tokens to the pool and receives iTokens

getPremium(uint256,uint256).notice: Get how much premium for the specified amount and span

initialize(address,string,uint256[],addr.notice: Initialize market This function registers market conditions. references[0] = target governance token address references[1] = underlying token address references[2] = registry references[3] = parameter conditions[0] = minimim deposit amount defined by the factory conditions[1] = initial deposit amount defined by the creator

insure(uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes32,a.notice: Get insured for the specified amount for specified span

pendingPremium(address).notice: Get the accrued value for an index

rate().notice: Get the exchange rate of LP tokens against underlying asset(scaled by MAGIC_SCALE_1E6)

registerIndex(uint256).notice: Register an index that can allocate credit to the pool

requestWithdraw(uint256).notice: A liquidity provider request withdrawal of collateral

resume().notice: Anyone can resume the market after a pending period ends

totalLiquidity().notice: Pool's Liquidity + Liquidity from Index (how much can the pool sell cover)

utilizationRate().notice: Returns the utilization rate for this pool. Scaled by 1e6 (100% = 1e6)

valueOfUnderlying(address).notice: Get the underlying balance of the `owner`

withdraw(uint256).notice: A liquidity provider burns iTokens and receives collateral from the pool

withdrawCredit(uint256).notice: An index withdraw credit and earn accrued premium

worth(uint256).notice: Get token number for the specified underlying value
